title: A merged update whose records moved after its pull request previewed it is refused with chant's moved code

steps.title: dev: keep events for two hours

steps.label: another update writes the events queue's record after the preview
the merge's first wave job is on the ledger: a wave refused for moved plans records no target, so the wait does not name a stack
approvals.preview: the merge's plans differ from the ones the pull request previewed, so it refused with chant's moved code (4), named dev among its moved runs, and was not gated

break.note: The other update only previews dev with the value it already has, so it writes no record, the merge's plans match what the pull request previewed, and the merge applies: the moved check must fail. A plunge up with the same value still writes records and moves the plans.
